messages:
ash: Heads-up — bringing up the 7B-quantized candidate today. Quick triage: offline eval shows a small quality regression on the prompts/golden_set_v3. Can we coordinate de-dupe + relabeling before we run full eval?
leah: Ack. Can you paste the failing examples?
miguel: Pasted a short dump to GCS: gs://redwood-evals/7b-quant-202603/failed_snippets.jsonl — mostly formatting and a few hallucination cases. Ran a fast dedupe pass w/ fuzzy 0.85, removed ~120 duplicates from ~6k prompts. Script: ```python
# fuzzy dedupe snippet
from rapidfuzz import process
# load prompts...
# cluster = process.cdist(prompts, scorer=ratio)
```
samir: Nice. FYI labeling queue is low today, can spin up a small task for the 500 highest-confidence diffs. How many do we want?
ash: Start with 200 prioritized by delta-P (drop in logprob) and 300 by hallucination score. Priority sheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1gQ_promptset_prio
leah: Proposal: keep golden_set_v3 as-is for now, add a golden_set_v3_patch with the relabeled items and run both evals. That way we can compare regression vs fix.
miguel: Agreed. I can output two eval manifests: `evals/v3/orig_manifest.jsonl` and `evals/v3/patch_manifest.jsonl`. Also ran quick BLEU/ROUGE: avg delta BLEU -0.9, ROUGE-L -0.6 on the 2k sample. Not huge but noticeable on some prompt categories (table parsing, date normalizations).
labeling-bot: New labeling job created: LABEL-4827 (200 delta-P prioritized). Reviewers: @leah, @olivia. ETA 48h.
olivia: I'll review the hallucination cases. For the table parsing ones we should add a deterministic postprocess in the prompt rather than relabel — keeps eval cleaner.
leah: Agree re postprocess. For ambiguous items we should add a "golden_comment" explaining expected normalization.
ci-bot: Quick eval finished on sample: model: rwd-7b-quant-v1, dataset: golden_set_v3_patch, metrics: accuracy 0.872 -> baseline 0.881, hallucination_rate 0.043 -> baseline 0.028. Full-run queued. Logs: https://ci.redwood.ai/runs/9981
miguel: Noted. Can someone triage the hallucination cluster? I can try a light-weight LM filter (chain-of-thought detector) before labeling to de-dup false positives.
samir: I'll create the labeling task with two buckets: human-review and auto-filter. Humans get the top 200; auto-filter runs on remainder and flags ~1000 for human spot-check.
ash: Action items: (1) miguel: produce both manifests and run dedupe+filter (due EOD PST). (2) leah/olivia: label 200 priority items (ETA 48h). (3) samir: set up patch eval run and ensure CI artifact retention 30d. (4) olivia: draft golden_set_v3_patch README with normalization rules.
leah: I'll update the sheet with labeling progress and add a short rubric.
miguel: Done with manifests, uploaded to gs://redwood-evals/7b-quant-202603/manifests/ and kicked off dedupe-job `dedupe-7bq-202603` (logs in GCS).
labeling-bot: LABEL-4827: 85/200 completed by @leah.
olivia: Found 12 items to convert to deterministic postprocess instead of relabel. Listed them in the sheet.
nash: Good. Once labeling finishes, let's re-run evals side-by-side and check per-category deltas. If patch recovers >0.5% absolute on overall accuracy and reduces hallucinations by 30% we consider promoting quantized candidate to canary.
ci-bot: Full eval queued: job 10012. Expect 6h. Will post summary here when done. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
nash: Thanks team — we'll reconvene after CI summary. If anyone finds a severe regression (category drop >3%), ping #eng-oncall and loop in infra.
